title: KineticAI-AWGC: A Computational Platform for Predictive Materials Design and the Kinetic Blueprint Framework
description: Open computational materials-science platform for spray-pyrolyzed apatite-wollastonite glass-ceramics: experimental datasets, kinetic modeling (Korsmeyer-Peppas transport), machine-learning phase prediction, and reproducible notebooks. Computational foundation of the Kinetic Blueprint Framework.
